change: R-7: verification/datasets/financials.py signs corrections and reversals
defect: A reversal row carries the ORIGINAL amount POSITIVE - CHECK amount>0 on payments and amount>=0 on extra_charges forbid anything else - and the application requires every caller to flip the sign (app/models.py Payment and ExtraCharge, services.post_payment_correction, services.signed_extra_charge_amount). financials.py summed amount unsigned, so a reversal ADDED where it must SUBTRACT.
magnitude: wrong by twice the reversed amount on every correction. Measured on a copy with one 500.00 charge correction and one 1000.00 payment correction: extra_charges_total 1929.85 vs truth 929.85; payments_net 42244.29 vs truth 40244.29; outstanding -1200.08 vs truth -200.08.
why_invisible: production has zero correction and zero reversal rows, so INV-D02 is VACUOUS and the signing logic is untested by live data - INV-D02 says so in its own VACUOUS message. Same shape as R-2, which was harmless while zero night rates were posted.
why_now: DS-ACT-CORRECTION is the first dataset that will produce this shape. Declaring its financial expectations against unsigned probes would bake the defect into the baseline permanently - the failure the D5.5 remediation existed to prevent.

changed.payments_net: now net of voids AND reversals
changed.outstanding: now uses signed charges and signed payments

added.extra_charges_net: signed sum of all extra charges
added.charges_net: room revenue + signed non-room-rent extras + tax, so the balance is decomposable

unchanged_on_purpose.extra_charges_total: unsigned gross - answers how much was raised, and a reversal pair really did raise both rows

commissioning: 19 checks, 0 failed. NEUTRAL on production (every probe reads what it read before) AND CORRECT under injection (signed probes report business truth; the pre-R-7 forms are shown wrong by twice the reversed amount). A fix whose only evidence is nothing-changed is indistinguishable from no fix.
